tools.name: search_footage
tools.description: Search footage.cool's library of 54,000+ drone, aerial, ocean, underwater, wildlife, and travel clips (4K UHD masters on nearly all), filmed by Phil Maher mostly in Baja California Sur (Los Cabos, Cabo Pulmo, East Cape, La Paz, Todos Santos), plus the Colorado Rockies and the California coast, 2014

tools.name: get_clip_details
tools.description: Get full details for one footage.cool clip: description, tags, location, shot year, duration, people and release notice, collection, thumbnail, watermarked preview, clip page, the master's verified resolution and codec when known, and licensing options with prices.

tools.name: find_similar_footage
tools.description: Find clips similar to a given clip: shared subjects, scene, location, and shot year, spread across different shoots so the results are not near-duplicates. Use it to offer alternatives or to keep a sequence consistent.

tools.name: build_rough_cut
tools.description: Plan a timed edit from a description: picks and orders clips across different shoots and locations, sets a cut length for each at the chosen pace, and totals the license cost. Returns an edit decision list with preview URLs for a storyboard or rough cut. It does not render video or license anything.

tools.name: check_clip_rights
tools.description: Screen whether a license covers an intended use for a clip and which tier fits: commercial, editorial, documentary, internal_corporate, digital (web and social), broadcast, theatrical, or ai_training. Reports chain of title, people and property flags, and the release policy. Catalog screening, not l

tools.name: license_clip
tools.description: Get licensing options and prices for a clip without charging anything: Royalty-Free Standard (from $79), Extended for broadcast (from $199), and Exclusive Buyout (quoted by email). This tool never issues a license or takes payment; quote_4k_license starts a purchase.

tools.name: quote_4k_license
tools.description: Quote a license for a clip's clean, unwatermarked master. Verifies the master file in storage and reports its exact resolution and codec: nearly every master is 4K UHD, and when one is lower (HD 1080p or 2.7K) the quote includes a resolution_notice that you must pass on to the user. tools.name: create_4k_checkout
tools.description: Create or resume Stripe hosted checkout for a quote. Call ONLY after the user explicitly approves the quoted clip, the master resolution, license type, total price, and terms. Returns a checkout URL for the user and a private order token. The user pays securely on Stripe; never collect card details

tools.name: get_4k_order
tools.description: Check an order after checkout. Verifies the payment directly with Stripe, then returns the active license, receipt, license certificate link, and a private download link for the clean master. tools.name: get_catalog_overview
tools.description: Overview of what footage.cool's library covers: clip counts by shot year, scene category, subject, and location (grouped by region), people versus no-people counts, and pricing. Use it to see what exists and to find valid category values for search_footage and build_rough_cut.

tools.name: describe_training_dataset
tools.description: What footage.cool licenses for AI and machine-learning training: the eligible catalog (clip and hour counts, years, countries, categories), the three tiers (free evaluation sample, research, commercial) with fixed prices, payment rails, the review policy, filters, the agreement version and hash, and

tools.name: get_dataset_agreement
tools.description: The full Dataset License Agreement text with its version, SHA-256 hash, and key_terms, a plain-language summary. Show the buyer the key terms and the full text (or its URL) before they accept; accept_dataset_agreement requires the hash back, which proves the current version was presented.

tools.name: scope_training_dataset
tools.description: Count the clips and hours a set of filters matches, with an estimated price for the tier and media. Free, needs no email, and reserves nothing. Use it to size a request before quoting.

tools.name: quote_training_dataset
tools.description: Create a fixed-price quote for a dataset order. Freezes a clip selection unique to this order, prices it, screens the buyer's email domain, and returns a private order_token plus the agreement hash. Ask the user for the buyer's work email at their organization (consumer mailboxes are refused), the o

tools.description: Accept the Dataset License Agreement for a quoted order on the buyer's behalf. Call ONLY after the buyer has seen the tier, clip count, price, payment method, the agreement key terms, and the full agreement text, and has explicitly agreed. The buyer receives the accepted text by email. Free evaluati

tools.name: create_dataset_checkout
tools.description: Payment step for an accepted dataset order. Proxy orders up to $10,000 get a Stripe hosted checkout URL that the buyer pays in a browser; 4K, research, and larger orders get a bank-wire invoice emailed to the buyer. Never collect card details in chat. Calling again returns the same checkout or invoi

tools.name: get_dataset_order
tools.description: Status of a dataset order: payment, agreement, the manual review decision, and, once delivered, the private download manifest URL. Poll no faster than every 10 minutes while waiting for review. Keep the token and download links private.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_footage, build_rough_cut, license_clip, quote_4k_license, get_dataset_agreement, create_dataset_checkout, get_dataset_order · Private data: quote_4k_license, create_4k_checkout, get_4k_order, quote_training_dataset, get_dataset_order · Public sink: check_clip_rights, license_clip, quote_4k_license, scope_training_dataset, quote_training_dataset, accept_dataset_agreement.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_footage, build_rough_cut, license_clip, quote_4k_license, get_dataset_agreement, create_dataset_checkout, get_dataset_order · Private data: quote_4k_license, create_4k_checkout, get_4k_order, quote_training_dataset, get_dataset_order · Public sink: check_clip_rights, license_clip, quote_4k_license, scope_training_dataset, quote_training_dataset, accept_dataset_agreement

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
